At the Heart of Sunmarke: A Message from the Principal
A Passionately Character-Building & Innovative School in the Middle East.
A Place to Thrive
Welcome to Sunmarke School, ​Where Amazing Happens​
At Sunmarke, we understand that every student is unique, with their own strengths, interests and aspirations. That is why we have developed a wide range of academic pathways that allow us to cater to the individual needs of every student. We are one of the very few schools to offer students the choice of A-level, the IB Diploma Programme and BTEC. By providing such enviable options and personalising learning experiences, we empower students to explore their passions and reach their full potential in a supportive and dynamic environment.
One of our key areas of focus is Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Mathematics. Our STEAM and Design Thinking curriculum fosters creativity, critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Through hands-on projects, collaborative learning and exposure to real-world applications, Sunmarke students learn how to code and develop the essential skills of tech literacy and digital fluency.

British Ethos That Guides Learning and Life
As a British Schools Overseas (BSO) accredited school, Sunmarke School is committed to upholding the values and standards of a world-class British education. This commitment includes a strong focus on the spiritual, moral, social and cultural development of our students, alongside the promotion of respect, tolerance and responsibility.
These principles align seamlessly with the values of the UAE, where respect for diversity and cultural understanding form the foundation of daily life. Together, these shared values shape our school community into one that is inclusive, aspirational and globally minded.
School policies, codes of conduct and classroom expectations help pupils understand fairness, responsibility and the importance of living within agreed rules, reflecting the laws of the UAE.
We encourage independence and student choice in learning, while ensuring safety and guidance so pupils understand the balance between rights and responsibilities.

Can students join without being in a Fortes school?
The Fortes Pro Sports Academy at Sunmarke is primarily designed for students enrolled in Fortes Education schools, ensuring seamless integration between academic schedules and elite training. However, a limited number of external places are offered each season for exceptional young athletes who demonstrate both talent and commitment. These places are highly competitive and subject to a selection process that includes coach assessment and performance evaluation.

chunks.section: Are training sessions during school hours?
chunks.text:
Are training sessions during school hours?
Our training structure is thoughtfully designed around the school day to maintain the perfect balance between academic achievement and athletic growth. Most sessions take place during school ECAs or after-school hours, allowing students to commit fully without compromising classroom performance. Selected performance squads may also benefit from early morning or weekend sessions, tailored to support high-level competition readiness, as well as talent enhancement sessions that take place during PE lessons to further develop individual skills and game understanding.

Scholarships are awarded to student-athletes who display outstanding potential, consistency, and a positive training attitude. Selection is based on a combination of data analysis, coach observation, representation in a range of sports at a high level, and the student’s overall contribution to team culture and leadership. Beyond athletic ability, we recognise character — resilience, humility, and commitment — as the foundation of every Fortes scholar’s success.More details can be found on our school website in the ‘Scholarships’ section.

Think and Thrive
Think & Thrive is Sunmarke’s very own Speaker Series linking innovators, artists, sports personalities, and business leaders in the region with savvy students. A student moderated event, ‘Think & Thrive’ allows them to interact with guests in a unique, studio-style setting and is an initiative that ensures our Secondary students receive the opportunity to connect with industry leaders to help them make better career choices. Top CEO’s, business leaders, sports personalities, artists and entrepreneurs share stage with our student moderator to share life experiences with them.
Our most recent Think & Thrive guest this term was Oscar-nominated filmmaker Shekhar Kapur , who shared inspiring insights on creativity, storytelling, leadership, and resilience with our students. The session provided students with an exceptional opportunity to gain first-hand insights into the creative industry through an engaging and thought-provoking discussion with one of the world’s most celebrated filmmakers.
